Quilt values by OM and MP, as a heat map

Source: R/Slick_plots.R
PlotQuiltOM.Rd

Plots one Quilt performance indicator for each OM (columns) and MP (rows), with the value in each cell. Values below a minimum (e.g. the minimum probability of an objective) are shown in bold.

Usage

PlotQuiltOM(
  slick,
  PI = 1,
  MPs = NULL,
  OMs = NULL,
  minimum = NULL,
  limits = c(0, 1),
  low = "#f2f6fc",
  high = "#174a8b",
  digits = 2,
  fill_title = NULL,
  OM_label = c("code", "name"),
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "serif"
)

Arguments

slick

A Slick object.

PI

Index or code of the Quilt performance indicator.

MPs

Codes or indices of the MPs (rows, in this order). Defaults to all.

OMs

Codes or indices of the OMs (columns). Defaults to all.

minimum

Optional value below which values are shown in bold.

limits

Limits of the colour scale.

low, high

Colours of the ends of the (single-hue) colour scale.

digits

Number of decimal places.

fill_title

Title of the colour legend. Defaults to the label of the PI.

OM_label

'code' (first column of the OM design) or 'name'.

base_size, base_family

Passed to theme_slick_print().

Value

A ggplot2 object.
